## Description

Tickets are conversations with a queue, owner, SLA and internal notes. Patient-to-clinic tickets are tenant data handled by clinic staff; the AI drafts a reply that staff approve (rules of MDV-P4-019). Clinic-to-Medvya tickets carry the tenant id and scrubbed diagnostics but no patient data, and appear in the platform console (MDV-P5-047).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** No AI draft is sent without staff approval; clinical questions route to a clinician.
- [ ] **AC2.** A clinic-to-Medvya ticket cannot carry a patient identifier; the platform console never shows patient data (test).
- [ ] **AC3.** SLA breach is visible on the ticket and in notifications.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
